description:
Configure a synchronized multi-chart dashboard in NinjaTrader 8.

Scenario: You are a day trader who needs to monitor SPY, AAPL, and MSFT simultaneously. You need a workspace where changing the timeframe on one chart updates all of them, and moving your mouse on one chart shows the cursor position on all others.

Task:
1. Create three separate chart windows: one for SPY, one for AAPL, and one for MSFT.
2. Configure 'Interval Linking' on all three charts to 'Green' (this links their timeframes).
3. Configure 'Global Crosshair' on all three charts (so the cursor is visible across all windows).
4. Set the timeframe of the charts to '60 Minute' bars (changing one should update all if linked correctly).
5. Save the workspace.

Note: The default workspace name is likely 'Untitled' or 'Multi-Asset'. You can save to the current workspace or create a new one, as long as it is saved.
